title: The Trains that Subsidize Suburbia - GO Transit Commuter Rail
summary: Not Just Bikes examines Toronto's GO Transit commuter rail, arguing it is a costly system with park-and-ride stations and rush-hour-only service that subsidizes car-dependent suburbs.
why: Cited in transit debates to show the cost and low utilization of commuter rail and the case for dense housing around stations.
